About_&_Key_Points:
About
Company is engaged in engineering and contract construction, delivering state of-the-art infrastructure and buildings projects for clients in India.
Company has experiences in working on residential, commercial, institutional, corporate offices, power plants, hospitals, hotels, IT parks, Metro stations and depots, and automated car parking lots for Government as well as private clients.
